paragraph: John Travolta, a prominent member of the Church of Scientology, has spoken out against HBO's documentary "Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief." He stated that he has not seen the documentary and has no interest in doing so. Travolta defended his positive experience with Scientology and dismissed the documentary as the result of disgruntled individuals. He praised the church for helping him cope with the death of his son.
